# Arcturus Professional Services

Arcturus Professional Services is the independent freelance practice of Khushboo Tomar. Khushboo is based in New Delhi, India and serves businesses in Ireland, the United Kingdom, and wider Europe. Communication is written through email and WhatsApp. Phone calls and call-booking appointments are not offered.

## Services

- LinkedIn Management: Profile optimisation, authority content, posting, targeted outreach, and nurture. EUR 400 per month. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/linkedin-management
- Email Outreach: GDPR and PECR-aware B2B campaign setup, warm-up, follow-ups, unsubscribe handling, and reporting. EUR 450 per month. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/email-outreach
- Business Support: Remote research, administration, website support, AI-assisted content, LinkedIn posting, YouTube support without SEO, and agreed ad management. EUR 12 per hour. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/business-support
- Lead Generation: Verified B2B contact research by company size, title, industry, and location. EUR 0.80 per verified business contact. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/lead-generation
- AI Video Creation: Basic custom AI videos and reels with branding, logo, business details, and end cards. Up to 30 videos per month for EUR 400 per month. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/ai-video-creation
- Email Setup: Business email and DNS configuration including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. EUR 80 one-time. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/email-setup
